## About me {.central}

I am a Research Fellow in Statistics at [Institute for Applied Mathematics and Information Technologies “Enrico Magenes” (CNR-IMATI)]{style="color: palevioletred; font-weight: bold;"}. I currently live in Italy.

::: research-box
### Research overview
My research lies at the intersection of reinforcement learning and statistics, with a focus on partial observability and feedback-driven adaptation. In particular, I study questions of statistical inference and robustness in sequential learning problems, and I am currently exploring applications in autonomous driving and water tank control systems.
:::

**Research interests**: Reinforcement Learning, Applied Statistics, Safe reinforcement learning

**E-mail**: valentina.zangirolami\@gmail.com

**Hobbies**: I like travelling, especially nearby the sea, and spending time with my cat. Over the past year, I have also started learning Mandarin Chinese :)
